subject: Residency pin + cross-region backups — follow-up and asks
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Martinez <emily.martinez@medisys.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Residency pin + cross-region backups — follow-up and asks

Hi Emily — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups so your procurement and security teams have the pieces they asked for.

Recap (one-liners):
- Scope: Proof-of-concept for anonymized triage agent + embeddings for clinical notes (no PHI in model payloads for POC; production will include PII controls).
- Primary region requirement: EU (Frankfurt) primary processing; US as warm standby for failover.
- Main asks from your legal/security: retention limits for logs, where decrypted payloads are stored, and guarantees around cross-region replication.

As discussed, we can pin workspace/model traffic to an EU-only fleet for normal operations and configure cross-region failover policies that keep KV cache and event logs off the standby region unless failover is triggered. Two quick clarifying questions so we can prepare the exact language for procurement:

1) For incident response and debug — do you require any short-lived access to raw request payloads from the US region during a declared failover, or should we plan for access via a read-only EU archive only?
2) For backups: do you need cross-region encrypted backups replicated automatically (RPO 1h) or would an EU-only backup with export-on-request suffice for your compliance reviewers?

I’ve attached a short (one-pager) residency summary and a sample data-map showing where PII/PHI would be stored for the POC. Laura and Marissa are cc’d to confirm the technical options and propose recommended defaults.

Next steps:
- Laura: can you confirm the EU-only default for snapshots and logs + what we can promise under our standard Private contract?
- Marissa: can you add estimated RTO/RPO numbers for the warm-standby option and an example simple failover play?
- Emily: if you can confirm answers to Q1/Q2 above, I’ll draft the procurement language and a short SOW addendum.

Thanks — look forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Martinez <emily.martinez@medisys.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 12:37:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Residency pin + cross-region backups — follow-up and asks

Hi Karthik — thanks for the summary and the materials. A few notes from our side after running this by security and legal this afternoon.

Answers to your questions:
1) Incident debug access: Legal prefers EU-only access by default. If we require access to raw request payloads from the US during an incident, it must be explicitly auditable, time-limited (max 30 days), and require a MediSys request + sign-off from our DPO.
2) Backups: we prefer EU-only encrypted backups for routine snapshots. We will request cross-region export only in case of prolonged outage (>24h) that impacts clinical availability.

Additional asks from security:
- Auditability: every cross-region replication or export action must generate an immutable audit event with operator identity and justification.
- Redaction: for model generations that might echo patient identifiers, we need a pre-forwarding redaction step — can Redwood provide a configurable pre-send filter or do we run that upstream?
- Log retention: default retention for operational logs should be 90 days; forensic logs (access to decrypted payloads) must be configurable to 30/90/365 day buckets.

Can Laura or Marissa confirm whether these map cleanly to your standard Dedicated/Private options or whether any of these are engineering-only changes?

Emily Martinez
Head of Product, Integrations
MediSys Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Martinez <emily.martinez@medisys.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Residency pin + cross-region backups — follow-up and asks

Thanks Emily — this is really helpful context. Short answers from an assurance perspective:

- EU-only default: yes, for Private and Dedicated we can pin processing and short-term caches to the EU fleet. Operational logs and snapshots can be configured to remain in-region by default.
- Incident debug access: supported via an export workflow that requires an on-platform approval workflow (operator identity + reason) and creates an immutable audit record. We can add a policy to require MediSys DPO sign-off for any decrypted payload export.
- Backup replication: EU-only automatic snapshots are standard. Cross-region replication (EU->US) is offered as an opt-in feature with an explicit SLA and export logs. We can set RPO targets; Marissa will propose numbers below.
- Audit events & retention: we support configurable retention buckets for forensic logs (30/90/365). Immutable audit events are written to an append-only ledger.
- Redaction: we offer an SDK hook (pre-send filter) that customers can run upstream before sending requests. For tighter controls, we offer optional on-platform redaction at point-of-ingress as a managed rule set (this is a Private-only capability due to performance/infra constraints).

I’ll work with legal to capture the DPO sign-off workflow language for the SOW addendum.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Martinez <emily.martinez@medisys.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Residency pin + cross-region backups — follow-up and asks

Hi Emily — quick engineering confirmation and proposed defaults for the POC: 

- RPO/RTO: Warm standby (EU primary, US warm): RPO = 1 hour (default snapshot frequency), estimated RTO = 30 minutes for autoscaling to route; full KV cache rebuild depends on session size but estimate 45–90 minutes for large stateful workloads. We can provide a low-latency cache-warmup migration for production as an add-on.
- Exports & audit: any automated cross-region replication will create a signed audit entry and an export-ticket id. Exports require an operator action and will be throttled to prevent accidental mass transfer.
- Redaction options: recommend upstream SDK pre-send filtering for the POC (lowest risk), and evaluate on-platform redaction for production Private deployment.
- Implementation notes: for the POC we’ll set: EU processing + EU snapshot retention (90 days for operational logs), no automatic EU->US replication. If you trigger an export, we’ll capture the event and retain the export ticket for 365 days.

If that matches your security needs I’ll update the SOW addendum and drop in explicit language for the incident/export workflow.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
